integrity: The proof derives the signed law exactly by convolution, proves the two-crossing structure from real-rootedness and coefficient sign variation, and derives all metric formulas from exact finite differences. Exact-rational computation replays the identities and sign structure.
scientific_limitations: The two-crossing and modal-Wasserstein simplifications require a Poisson-binomial background; only the finite-difference identities hold for arbitrary finite-support integer backgrounds.
The theorem quantifies one pair-balancing step and does not assert additivity of distances over multiple steps.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent statement in older total-positivity literature.
title: Exact two-crossing transport law for Bernoulli pair balancing
